evals.name: should-trigger-adapt-framework
evals.prompt: Adapt the framework to our app now that project-discovery is done: wire the auth and the first entity.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-framework-adaptation. Loads references/adaptation-workflow.md, runs the Phase 0 genericness scan and prerequisite check, and writes the plan to .context/reports/test-framework-adaptation-plan.md with Status: PENDING APPROVAL before any code write.

evals.name: should-trigger-wire-fixtures
evals.prompt: Wire the fixtures and the KATA components to our staging stack and delete the Example files.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-framework-adaptation. Starts at Phase 0, builds the GENERIC/ADAPTED table, and does not delete or edit anything until the plan is approved.

evals.name: should-trigger-recheck-generic
evals.prompt: Check how generic the repo still is and finish whatever adaptation is missing.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-framework-adaptation. Runs the Phase 9 detection signals first, lists the GENERIC rows as the work-list, and skips the ADAPTED rows.

evals.name: should-trigger-es-adaptar-framework
evals.prompt: Adapta el framework KATA a mi proyecto: conecta el login, las variables y los fixtures con el stack real.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-framework-adaptation from a Spanish prompt. Follows the same Phase 0-2 plan-first flow, replies in Spanish, and writes repo artifacts in English.

evals.name: should-trigger-es-conectar-boilerplate
evals.prompt: Conecta el boilerplate con el backend de mi app: configura la autenticación, el esquema de entorno y el CI.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-framework-adaptation from a Spanish prompt. Starts with the genericness scan and prerequisites, then writes the plan and waits for approval before Phase 3.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-write-feature-test
evals.prompt: Write an automated Playwright test for the checkout ticket PROJ-310 using the existing Page components.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate test-framework-adaptation. Routes to test-automation, because the framework is already adapted and the work is a ticket-level test.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-reverse-engineer-repo
evals.prompt: Reverse-engineer the target repo and generate the architecture and infrastructure maps for it.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not activate test-framework-adaptation. Routes to project-discovery, which owns the discovery maps and is the prerequisite of this skill.
